research_question: Can low-turnover weekly or monthly sector-neutral price factors produce a broad-PIT edge that intraday families missed?

sample.development: 2018-03-29 through 2021-12-31, with every development trade exited by 2021-12-31

data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; entry price >= 5; absolute opening gap <= 30%
data_contract.signals: ret20_pre, ret60_pre, and vol20_pre are known before the rebalance session opens
data_contract.sector_definition: PIT Polygon SIC description with minimum ten eligible names on the rebalance date
data_contract.weekly_schedule: first market session of each ISO week; exact 09:35 entry; exact 09:35 exit at the first session of the following ISO week
data_contract.monthly_schedule: first market session of each calendar month; exact 09:35 entry; exact 09:35 exit at the first session of the following month
data_contract.missing_exit: if an already-selected name lacks the exact scheduled 09:35 exit, assign a conservative 100% leg-notional loss at that rebalance regardless of direction; no delay, drop, or refill, preserving non-overlap

variants.name: weekly_sector_momo20
variants.rule: abs 20-session return minus SIC median >= 3%; trade with residual sign

variants.name: weekly_sector_momo60
variants.rule: abs 60-session return minus SIC median >= 5%; trade with residual sign

variants.name: weekly_sector_reversal20
variants.rule: abs 20-session return minus SIC median >= 5%; trade opposite residual sign

variants.name: weekly_consistent_lowvol_momo
variants.rule: 20d and 60d sector residuals have the same sign; abs residuals >= 2% and 3%; vol20_pre no greater than same-date median
variants.rank: absolute 20d residual plus half absolute 60d residual

variants.name: monthly_sector_blend_momo
variants.rule: 20d and 60d sector residuals have the same sign; abs residuals >= 2% and 5%; trade with sign
variants.rank: absolute 20d residual plus half absolute 60d residual

portfolio.selection: up to five names per side with matched long/short counts; rank after exact-entry filtering and fully refill each side
portfolio.weight: 5% current NAV absolute weight per leg; maximum 0.5x gross
portfolio.sic_cap: maximum one ticker per SIC per side
portfolio.overlap: none; each cohort exits at the next rebalance before the new cohort is sized

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe then CAGR among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five frozen rows. No post-result threshold, rebalance day, holding period, direction, ranking, or position-count changes.
production_policy: A validation pass permits further audit only, not production PASS.
